name: daily-brief
description: Scheduled dev briefs by email/Slack, one profile per teammate: the day's meetings, PRs awaiting their review ranked by urgency, PR blockers and progress, where each person stopped (the owner's Claude sessions, or a teammate's GSD agent state), a daily progress and design digest of chosen repos, a tracked effort's epic progress, each person's chosen topics across the org, Slack/email that needs them, the latest meeting notes and recordings (filed one folder per meeting in Drive), and PRs merged/opened in watched repos
